topk.selection_note: verified baseline fallback; zero standalone Top-K gain

gpu.selection_rule: predeclared development probe: P1 minimum and random-maximum, P2/P3 minimum controls; seed 1 each
gpu.measurement_boundary: whole one-case process command including bootstrap and heap initialization; final per-device RTL MPM report; not frozen weighted performance board
gpu.promotion: HOLD: diagnostic subset, version/physical/protocol/weights gates pending

protocol32.partition_method: Disjoint original command/memory assertion blocks, all reset and producer-stability assumptions retained; shared reset remains arbitrary with identical initial-reset assumption in each partition. Both physical port indices checked independently.
protocol32.scope: Original generic command and memory adapters only; not Vortex core, actual fault adapters, DMA replay or physical signoff
protocol32.proof_method: Command: explicit 32-step BMC. Each full-width memory port: initial four-step BMC plus successful temporal induction (unbounded), entails all 32 steps. All original covers reachable within 32 steps.

dma.hardware_scope: fresh SRAM-macro-bound Vortex core + real command/memory fault adapters + external memory bridge
dma.no_mixing_with_old_simx: Old 970/1000 SimX results are not combined with these 30 records into a formal baseline.
